title: LM Evaluation Harness
description: Documented public model evaluation harness (EleutherAI (open source)) for the AI Verification Suite capability area.
body:
LM Evaluation Harness is a documented model evaluation harness from EleutherAI (open source). The community-standard harness running hundreds of benchmarks reproducibly across language models.

How it works: It works by having each agent vote with a confidence weight and taking the confidence-weighted winner as the consensus.

Documented uses of this capability area include neural architecture search, automated hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation leaderboards, and AI safety red-teaming.
